description: Header file defining the GraphicBufferAllocator class for managing graphics buffer allocations in Android, including methods for allocating, freeing, and dumping buffer info.

classes.name: GraphicBufferAllocator
classes.description: Manages allocation and deallocation of graphics buffers, singleton pattern.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates and imports a gralloc buffer.

methods.name: allocateRawHandle
methods.description: Allocates a raw handle for a gralloc buffer without importing.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Deprecated method for allocation that does not use graphicBufferId.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated buffer handle.

methods.name: getTotalSize
methods.description: Returns total size of allocated buffers.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps buffer info into a string.

methods.name: dumpToSystemLog
methods.description: Outputs buffer info to system log.
